data.title: Aston Villa star Johan Manzambi withdraws from Switzerland's Nations League games - FOX Sports
data.content: Access and manage your favorites here. # Aston Villa star Johan Manzambi withdraws from Switzerland's Nations League games. BERN, Switzerland (AP) — Winger Johan Manzambi has withdrawn from Switzerland’s squad for two Nations League games and returned to his club Aston Villa. The 21-year-old star had calf pain this week and has not improved enough to play in the team’s Nations League second-tier group, the Swiss Football Association said on Thursday. Switzerland already leads the four-team group by five points ahead of the final two rounds, at Slovenia on Friday and hosting Scotland on Monday. A draw in Slovenia will promote the Swiss back to the next top-tier groups in 2028. Manzambi is a key starter for Villa, which has six games in 18 days after the international break, including in the Champions League at Galatasaray and hosting Paris Saint-Germain. data.title: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka to miss Nations League games after injury with Sunderland - FOX Sports
data.content: # Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka to miss Nations League games after injury with Sunderland. BERN, Switzerland (AP) — Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka has withdrawn from two Nations League games, the national federation said Monday, because of an injury when Sunderland played Chelsea in the Premier League. Switzerland’s most-capped player has not added to his 152 appearances since the World Cup. Xhaka captained the team in a controversial 3-1 extra-time loss to Argentina in the quarterfinals. Xhaka missed four Nations League games in the last international break because he was prosecuted for using a fake COVID-19 vaccine document in 2022. A first callup for defender Roggerio Nyakossi made him the sixth player in the squad who was born in Geneva and came through the academy of city club Servette yet never made an impact on its first team. The 22-year-old Nyakossi was sold in 2022 to Marseille and now plays in Belgium for Leuven.
